scenario: [LSER.13.14] x [LNUL.8.6]: under `nulls: skip` a null reading absorbs nothing, so it is no sample: it neither counts against `N` nor is refused. The control for `LSER.13.14_null_hold_counts_against_capacity`: the same shape -- `integral sliding 1_h` over a `Float?` slot with `capacity: 2`, three superseding asserts of one identity before a pump, 1.0 then null then null -- under `nulls: skip`. The identity has one sample pending at the third assert, and the arriving null is none, so every assert is admitted; after the pump the identity is one logical fact. PATH PINNED: the same pre-assert capacity check taking the skip arm for both the pending null and the arriving one (libds `capacity_reading_absorbs`; Mercury `ds.series.lser_13_14_absorbs`).
